title: Best Egg says an unauthorized third party acquired data from its Financial Health platform, including Social Security numbers
date_note: The day of the notice letter (dated November 24, 2026) filed with California's Attorney General; the register page gives no filing day. The letter says Best Egg detected suspicious activity on 26 October 2026; the register lists breach dates of 25 and 26 October 2026.
geo_basis: country; the notice names no city for the victim
summary: In a notice letter dated 24 November filed with California's Attorney General, Best Egg says it detected suspicious activity on its Best Egg Financial Health platform on 26 October 2026 and found an unauthorized third party gained access and acquired certain information. The letter lists name, date of birth, Social Security number, the financial account number used for loan payments and contact details. It offers 24 months of Experian IdentityWorks.
plain: Best Egg says someone without permission got into its Financial Health platform and took personal details, including Social Security numbers. It is offering 24 months of identity protection.
exec: Best Egg confirms in a regulator filing that data including Social Security numbers was acquired; its letter estimates that 4634 Rhode Island residents are affected.
action: Best Egg's letter offers 24 months of Experian IdentityWorks, with enrolment by March 31, 2027, and points to credit freezes, fraud alerts and the FTC's identity-theft guidance.
impact: Total number of people affected not stated in the letter; it estimates that 4634 Rhode Island residents are affected.

sources.name: California Attorney General: Best Egg breach notification
Best Egg notice of data breach (sample letter, 24 November 2026)

report.publisher: Best Egg (filed with the California Attorney General)
key_findings: On October 26, 2026, Best Egg detected suspicious activity on the Best Egg Financial Health platform.
An unauthorized third party gained access to the platform and acquired certain information.
Affected information includes name, date of birth, Social Security number, the financial account number used to pay a Best Egg loan, and other contact information.
recommendations: Enroll in Experian IdentityWorks (24 months) by March 31, 2027.

evidence.quote: we are offering complimentary access to Experian IdentityWorksSM for 24 months.
We estimate that 4634 Rhode Island resident(s) are affected by this incident.

validation.note: Primary: Best Egg's own notice letter of 24 November 2026, filed with and published by the California Attorney General (register entry sb24-633388). No independent publisher read.
